approach: A Carnot engine's efficiency and a Carnot refrigerator's coefficient of performance between the same two temperatures both come from the ratio of the cold to the hot temperature.

steps.text: Write the efficiency in terms of the temperature ratio.
Write the coefficient of performance of the refrigerator working between the same two temperatures.
Rewrite the coefficient of performance in terms of the efficiency and substitute.

common_mistakes.text: Using COP = 1/η instead of (1 − η)/η gives 2.
